result.description: OK only if the suite reported no failures and dev.ps1 exited 0.

passed.description: Assertions passed, from the Passed/failed/skipped line.

failed.description: Assertions failed, from the Passed/failed/skipped line.

skipped.description: Assertions skipped, from the Passed/failed/skipped line.

reason.description: Empty when result is OK; a short failure reason otherwise.
